text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] elevated 5xx rate observed on inference-gateway in us-west-2. error class: runtime::segfault / OOM during model-runner allocation. triggering pager to oncall.

maya: got the page, I'm on it. which route is noisy?

jordan: route: /v1/generate -> model: rdx-gpt-7b-quant. 5xx spike started ~5m ago. overall 5xx up to 3.6% from baseline 0.02%. p95 latency increased to 1.8s -> 3.4s for affected cluster.

leah: customer impact: a few PLG customers reporting timeouts; dedicated customers with pinned instances see degraded throughput but not full failure. no major billing anomalies yet.

maya: copying metrics: `curl -s https://obs.internal/redwood/metrics?route=rdx-gpt-7b-quant | jq '.errors | {5xx,timeouts,p50,p95}'` -> `{\"5xx\":0.036,\"timeouts\":0.014,\"p95\":3.4}`.

sre_pager: i'm in the channel. initiating live triage. please post a failing request id if you have one.

jordan: sample request id: req_2026-03-15_8f4b2e. logs show repeated `segfault at 0x0` coming from model-runner process pid 3247 on node inf-uw2-gpu-07.

maya: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l nodepool=gpu-usw2 -o wide` -> several runner pods RestartCount > 3. `kubectl describe pod inference-runner-3247` shows OOMKilled + kernel OOM messages.

leah: stack traces from core dump attached to logs:
```
#0 0x7f88a2b3 in mem_alloc (size=...)
#1 0x7a9f00 in kv_cache_init
#2 0x6f2c11 in runner_start
```
looks like allocation path in kv cache.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) drain and cordon inf-uw2-gpu-07 (evict bad pods) 2) failover route for quant model to unquantized safe variant for traffic 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size and disable prefix caching for this model.

jordan: rolling failover command: `redwood-cli routes set-fallback --route rdx-gpt-7b-quant --fallback rdx-gpt-7b-safe --reason \"runtime 5xx\"` -> applied, new traffic split 0->100% to safe variant in 30s.

devx-bot: Deploy bot: observed new routing applied, switching 100% to fallback model.

maya: kicking off node quarantine: `kubectl cordon inf-uw2-gpu-07 && kubectl drain inf-uw2-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` then scale up gpu pool by +2 nodes to absorb traffic.

leah: scaling done. after failover 5xx dropped from 3.6% -> 0.12% within 90s. some requests still failing from older connections (keepalive).

jordan: logs show repeated allocation failures when prefix cache hits > 64MB; that aligns with a regressed allocator in quant kernel after last runtime patch. rolling back kernel selection for quantized models might help.

maya: opened a regression issue: INF-5042 \"quant kernel allocator regression -> OOM/segfault on high-kv cache usage\" and linked core dumps + backtrace.

sre_pager: handoff note for next oncall: mitigation: traffic fully on safe variant, affected nodes cordoned and quarantined, gpu pool scaled +2, monitoring alert sensitivity increased. customer impact: 2% of requests from PLG experienced timeouts during window, no data exfiltration. next steps: hotfix to allocator or revert kernel selection; schedule off-hours patch.

leah: notifying account teams for customers with elevated errors. templated note: \"We're actively mitigating elevated errors affecting some generation requests; we've routed traffic to a safe model variant and isolated affected nodes. Expect normal service within 1 hour while we implement a hotfix.\"

maya: quick postmortem checklist: collect core dumps, gdb bt, kernel logs (`dmesg`), runner binary sha, model binary sha, last good kernel selection config, rollout window. I'll upload artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/4832101234/.

jordan: additional runbook commands for next shift:
```
# check for OOMs
journalctl -u model-runner -n 200 | grep -i oom
# check per-pod restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, restarts:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount}'
# reapply fallback
redwood-cli routes set-fallback --route rdx-gpt-7b-quant --fallback rdx-gpt-7b-safe --force
```

maya: timeline note: alert at T0 4832101234, failover completed T0+90s, node quarantine T0+3m, scaling complete T0+5m. last observed 5xx > baseline ended T0+7m.

sre_pager: leaving a pager handoff message for the next oncall: please continue watch on p95 latency and 5xx. investigate kernel selection delta in last runtime deploy (deploy id: runtime-2026-03-15-1937).

leah: thanks all — i'll update status page and customer comms. :white_check_mark:

maya: moving to incident review. adding owners: maya (oncall), jordan (observability), leah (customer comms), infra (hotfix). closing channel updates unless new symptoms appear. :lock:
